The '''Scientific Research Compound''' was a scientific compound in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that included the [[Primary Research Center]] and the [[prison medical center]] for the [[Belsavis prison]].
